messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Malayalam, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Malayalam line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
അപ്പോൾ നീ സന്തുഷ്ടരായവരെ കാണും അഗ്നിയിൽ അവർ വരാൻ പ്രതീക്ഷിക്കുന്നതിനാൽ, എപ്പോഴുമെങ്കിലും അത് ഭാഗ്യവാന്മാരായ ജനങ്ങളിലേക്കാണ്.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase (Malayalam) | Back‑Translation (English) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|----------------------------------|-----------------------------|--------| | e | coordinating conjunction “And then” | **അപ്പോൾ** | “then / at that time” | OK | | vederai | future verb “thou shalt see” | **കാണും** | “will see” | OK | | color | demonstrative pronoun “those” | **വരെ** (as part of “സന്തുഷ്ടരായവരെ”) | “those (people)” | OK | | che (relative) | relative pronoun “who” | — (relative clause is fused into the adjective) | — | UNNECESSARY | | son | copular verb “are” | — (state expressed by the adjective) | — | UNNECESSARY | | contenti | predicate adjective “contented” | **സന്തുഷ്ടരായ** | “contented” | OK | | nel | preposition “in the” | **അഗ്നിയിൽ** | “in the fire” | OK | | foco | noun “fire” | **അഗ്നി** (within “അഗ്നിയിൽ”) | “fire” | OK | | perché | causal conjunction “because” | **പ്രതീക്ഷിക്കുന്നതിനാൽ** | “because (they) hope” | OK | | speran | verb “they hope” | **പ്രതീക്ഷിക്കുന്ന** | “hoping” | OK | | di | infinitive marker “to” | **വരാൻ** (infinitive suffix “‑ാൻ”) | “to come” | OK | | venire | infinitive “come” | **വരാൻ** | “to come” | OK | | quando | temporal conjunction “whenever” | **എപ്പോഴുമെങ്കിലും** | “whenever” | OK | | che (idiom) | particle reinforcing “quando che” | — (no separate lexical item) | — | UNNECESSARY | | sia | subjunctive “it may be” | **ആണ്** | “is” (expresses potentiality in context) | OK | | a | preposition “to” | **ലേക്ക്** (within “ജനങ്ങളിലേക്കാണ്”) | “to” | OK | | le | definite article “the” (feminine plural) | — (articles are not expressed) | — | UNNECESSARY | | beate | adjective “blessed” | **ഭാഗ്യവാന്മാരായ** | “blessed” | OK | | genti | noun “folk” | **ജനങ്ങൾ** (within “ജനങ്ങളിലേക്കാണ്”) | “people / folk” | OK |
---
### Items flagged
- **UNNECESSARY**: `che` (relative), `son`, `che` (idiomatic), `le` – Malayalam does not require separate words for these functions; the meaning is conveyed through morphology or is omitted. - **OK**: All other source words have appropriate Malayalam equivalents with correct grammatical agreement. No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** errors were detected.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Malayalam script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Malayalam text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 118: - Original: **അപ്പോൾ നീ സന്തുഷ്ടരായവരെ കാണും** - Issue: none - Corrected: **no change**
- Line 119: - Original: **അഗ്നിയിൽ അവർ വരാൻ പ്രതീക്ഷിക്കുന്നതിനാൽ,** - Issue: trailing comma (source line has no end punctuation; internal commas are not allowed) - Corrected: **അഗ്നിയിൽ അവർ വരാൻ പ്രതീക്ഷിക്കുന്നതിനാൽ**
- Line 120: - Original: **എപ്പോഴുമെങ്കിലും അത് ഭാഗ്യവാന്മാരായ ജനങ്ങളിലേക്കാണ്.** - Issue: none - Corrected: **no change**
``` അപ്പോൾ നീ സന്തുഷ്ടരായവരെ കാണും അഗ്നിയിൽ അവർ വരാൻ പ്രതീക്ഷിക്കുന്നതിനാൽ എപ്പോഴുമെങ്കിലും അത് ഭാഗ്യവാന്മാരായ ജനങ്ങളിലേക്കാണ്. ```
